paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss of a reward model over time. The x-axis is labeled “Training Step”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 1400, and has tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled “Training Loss”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0.3 to 0.7, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.1. A single blue solid line represents the training loss, starting at a value of approximately 0.71 at a training step of 0, then decreasing to a value of approximately 0.38 at a training step of 200, before fluctuating between approximately 0.3 and 0.45 for the remainder of the x-axis range, ultimately reaching a value of approximately 0.35 at a training step of 1400.
